VoltPhish 2.7.1 — bug-fix release

**Fixed**
- **Email now always sends for real.** The console/dry-run mail backend that silently wrote "sent" emails to disk instead of delivering them — making campaigns and training appear sent while nobody received anything — has been removed. Real SMTP delivery via your Sending Profile is now unconditional. To rehearse without real email, point a profile at a local catch-all mailbox (Mailpit/MailHog).
- **Readable profile menu in light mode** (was near-white text on a white surface).
- **Theme-aware dropdowns & checkboxes** — native controls now follow the light/dark theme.

Update via **Settings → Software updates**, or pull the new Docker image / no-docker zip below.
